harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built and verified a persistent three-node Kubernetes cluster across both private LANs routed by node1. All nodes are Ready after sequential reboots; cross-LAN pod traffic, CoreDNS, and ClusterIP services work, with Kubernetes control and Flannel traffic pinned to private interfaces.
actions_performed: Configured and saved VyOS routing between 10.100.171.0/24 and 10.100.74.0/24 with scoped bidirectional forwarding rules.
Added persistent private-LAN routes on node2, node3, and node4.
Installed K3s v1.36.4+k3s1 with node2 as control plane and node3/node4 as workers.
Pinned node addresses, API advertisement, and Flannel VXLAN to the private LAN interfaces.
Deployed a persistent three-node echo workload and ClusterIP service for validation.
Restarted node1, node3, node4, then node2 individually; verified changed boot IDs and complete recovery after each.

evidence.summary: Shows node1's LAN addresses, routes, forwarding, scoped firewall rules and counters, plus successful private cross-LAN routing from every Kubernetes node.

evidence.requirement: Ready Kubernetes members using private control and data paths
evidence.summary: Shows private node IPs, private API binding, enp8s0 routes, Flannel VXLAN private endpoints, and all three nodes Ready.

evidence.requirement: Cross-LAN pod networking, cluster DNS, and ClusterIP services
evidence.summary: Final post-restart test shows DNS resolution, ClusterIP responses, and successful all-to-all direct pod-IP access from pods on node2, node3, and node4.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart and router recovery
evidence.summary: Captures healthy router baseline, reboot acknowledgment, changed boot ID, restored addresses/routes/firewall, live forwarding counters, and recovered cross-LAN cluster traffic.

evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart and control-plane recovery
evidence.summary: Captures healthy API/data baseline, reboot acknowledgment, changed boot ID, restored private networking and Flannel, API readiness, Ready membership, CoreDNS, services, endpoints, and final all-to-all traffic.

evidence.requirement: node3 mandatory restart and worker recovery
evidence.summary: Captures healthy worker baseline, reboot acknowledgment, changed boot ID, restored route/Flannel/agent and local pod, ClusterIP data, Ready rejoin, DNS, and cross-LAN pod traffic.

evidence.requirement: node4 mandatory restart and worker recovery
evidence.summary: Captures healthy worker baseline, reboot acknowledgment, changed boot ID, restored route/Flannel/agent and local pod, ClusterIP data, Ready rejoin, DNS, and cross-LAN pod traffic.
